description: Add something to sell on the page: a download, a call or service, something shipped (physical), or a tip jar. Buyers open its page (stomp.to/<handle>/p/<link>), choose any options and pay on Stripe; nobody pays through an AI app. Prices are in US dollars. Confirm the price with the user before setting or changing it. Write the title and description from what the user gives you (a file, a photo or a short brief). The file itself is uploaded in the editor; it can't be sent from here. Paid products can be added before Stripe is connected: the reply says what's still missing before it sells. Only the page's owner and admins add products.

compareAt.description: The price before a sale, shown struck through (more than the price), in US dollars, like 12 or 12.50.

description.description: What buyers get, shown on the product's page.

endsAt.description: When it stops showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

imageUrls.description: Up to 4 https links to PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF photos (up to 2 MB each).

kind.description: download (a file), service (a call or service), physical (something shipped) or tip (a tip jar).

price.description: The price in US dollars, like 12 or 12.50; 0 (or leaving it out) makes it free, except a physical product, which needs a price. Use pwyw instead for pay what you want; tip jars use pwyw and ignore price. Confirm the price with the user before setting or changing it.

pwyw.description: Pay what you want instead of a fixed price. A tip jar defaults to from $1, suggesting $3, $5 and $10.

min.description: The smallest amount a buyer can pay (at least 0.50), in US dollars, like 12 or 12.50.

suggested.description: Up to 3 amounts to suggest, in dollars, none below the smallest.

quantity.description: How many can be sold in all. Leave out for no limit.

question.description: A question buyers answer at checkout, like what name to sign it to.

serviceNote.description: Calls, services and tips: what buyers read after paying, like a booking link. A call or service needs it before it sells.

shipping.description: Physical products: a flat shipping price; 0 is free shipping, in US dollars, like 12 or 12.50.

startsAt.description: When it starts showing, ISO 8601 with a time zone, e.g. 2026-12-01T18:00:00-08:00. Ask the user's time zone if unsure. null clears it.

title.description: Its name on the page. Needed, except for a tip jar ("Buy me a coffee").

name: add_product
title: Sell something
